label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Tu derecha, Jehová, gloriosa en la fuerza; tu derecha, Jehová, quiebra al enemigo.
spanish: Tu derecha, Jehová, gloriosa en la fuerza; tu derecha, Jehová, quebrará a enemigo.
grammarChanges: Changed smoothed present 'quiebra' to the Qal imperfect 3fs future-tense form 'quebrará' (feminine subject, person, and qal stem preserved).
Changed 'al enemigo' to 'a enemigo' to drop the supplied definite article, since the Hebrew participle is anarthrous; singular 'enemigo' and its object role are unchanged.
readerNote: Chose 'a enemigo' over 'al enemigo' to avoid supplying a definite article absent from the anarthrous Hebrew participle, without adding an indefinite article instead.
